remark:
The guest sent email after c/o because, he was disturbed by noise from the room above, likely from cleaning and breakfast preparation in the lounge area. The noise, which started around 4:00 AM and lasted for nearly two hours, was not excessively loud but was repetitive (every 20-60 seconds) and noticeable during the quiet early morning hours, preventing the guest from getting a good night's sleep. As a result, they missed out on breakfast and other hotel services, so requested compensation. It was later confirmed that the noise had originated from a filming session held in the lounge upstairs during the early morning hours.

AGRM has offered the guest a complimentary upgrade to an Executive Han River View Room for their next stay if they book a Deluxe Room and contact us in advance. (Informed them that such upgrades may not be available during peak seasons like holidays or the year-end fireworks period.)

However, the guest strongly demanded compensation equivalent to the room rate, and the entire incident was reported to the DOR. Eventually, a complimentary meal voucher for Zest was offered to him, and fortunately, he accepted it.

remark:
At 08:30am on 7/1, Female guest informed CS that someone who is wearing dark color of skirt just came into the room and spoke the door was opened.  CS delivered sincere apologies, and guest continued to complain strongly that the same issue would not cause even in the motels CS carefully asked if hotel could reach the guest back after checking CCTV. Guest kept expressing anger since the guest was not wearing underwear inside pajamas. CS apologized over and over. CS requested SEC to check CCTV, and it turned out HSK staff entered the room @08:20am. CS reported it to AGRM Aaron.Guest was upset at checked out at 09:00am. AGRM attended guest with sincere apology. Guest strongly complained that guest is checking out even though guest had checked in at late night (22:00pm) and did not use any hotel facilities at all.
Guest strongly requested refund or equivalent monetary compensation regarding the issue. While investigation, it turned out that the housemaid got in to guest room without proper action prior to entering guest room.(Even though the door was slightly opened, housemaid should have checked the indagator or at least ring the bell to check if guest was in the room) AGRM delivered sincere apology and promised to give guest call back with proper compensation.Under FOM's direction, AGRM offered guest comp Zest Voucher for 2 people or comp room upgrade to suite with pet (as guest had stayed in deluxe room with pet package).Guest will give hotel call back after discussion with their accompany. On 7/3, guest requested AGRM to provide Zest Voucher for 4 people. AGRM honored the offer. The voucher will be delivered via registered mail.

 By offering additional F&B vouchers to help cover personal expenses (e.g., meals not covered by company policy or team dinners), we can strengthen loyalty and make it easier for travelers to choose Conrad Seoul despite rate parity with competitors.
 Such tailored incentives—like vouchers, tier-matching, or bonus HH points—support their forecasted growth in room nights and help us retain share against an actively competing compset.


So we plan to extend the Q3 promotion - giving them some benefits (F&B coupons - 1 coupon per stay over 3 nights, HH bonus points, HH tier matching). 

Please issue the coupons accordingly.

--> 40 sheets of KRW50,000 F&B vouchers expiring on May 31st, 2026

remark: At 06:50am, the male guest complained FD GSA that shower booth has clogged and water is overflowed. His wife slipped on the slippery floor and injured her ankle and ribs. FD GSA delivered sincere apology and guest request visit the room immediately. FD GSA sent ENG team right away to check on it. ENG unclogged it by removing hair in the shower booth. The guest said it's not necessary to go to the hospital and declined cleaning the room. FD GSA reported it to NM Jason and left C/O alert for further apology with manager. Guest called CS and complained about how addressing the shower booth was prioritized over caring for the guest who had fallen due to shower booth drain clogged. AGRM was about to meet the guest upon check out, but immediately visited the room. When AGRM visited the room, guest was disappointed the way handling the guest especially when guest got injured. AGRM did sincerely apologized over and over. Guest barely accept and left the hotel. AGRM did courtesy call for checking condition. She is fine. AGRM offered to visit hospital. Guest did not need to visit hospital. AGRM delivered sincerely apologies. And she is nicely accepted it. AGRM offered Zest Voucher for 2pax. Guest nicely accepted it.
